## Acronyms {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- **ABI**: application binary interface. Not defined here; used in [Build options and test registration (`cmake -DNAME=value`)](#sec-ch12-build).
- **API**: application programming interface. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- **BLAS**: Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [The notation index](#sec-appa-index).
- **CFL**: Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy. Defined in [Time-step bound: acoustic, implicit-advective, shear and diffusive (`integration/cfl`)](#sec-ch07-cfl).
- **CI**: continuous integration. Not defined here; used in [The corrected-PE face gravity work (`SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`)](#sec-ch06-dwork).
- **CPU**: central processing unit. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- **CUDA**: NVIDIA's parallel computing platform. Not defined here; used in [Accumulate and combine one stage (`user_stage_forcings`)](#sec-ch01-stage).
- **EOS**: equation of state. Defined in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- **GIL**: global interpreter lock. Not defined here; used in [Expose the C++ API to Python (`import snapy`)](#sec-ch01-python).
- **GPU**: graphics processing unit. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- **HLLC**: Harten–Lax–van Leer solver with the contact restored. Defined in [HLLC (`type: hllc`)](#sec-ch04-hllc).
- **IO**: input/output. Not defined here; used in [Locate dependencies outside snapy (`find_package`)](#sec-ch01-dependencies).
- **KKT**: Karush–Kuhn–Tucker. Defined in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- **LF**: Lax–Friedrichs. Not defined here; used in [The Riemann solver framework and the face-local frame (`dynamics/riemann-solver`)](#sec-ch04-riemann).
- **LLF**: local Lax–Friedrichs. Defined in [Roe, with a Lax–Friedrichs positivity fallback (`type: roe`)](#sec-ch04-roe).
- **LMARS**: low-Mach approximate Riemann solver. Defined in [LMARS (`type: lmars`)](#sec-ch04-lmars).
- **LU**: lower–upper matrix factorisation. Not defined here; used in [Block Thomas sweep and back substitution: one serial pass up, one down, per column (`ForwardSweep`)](#sec-ch07-vic-sweep).
- **MC**: monotonised-central limiter. Defined in [PLM, the van Leer harmonic-mean slope (`type: plm`)](#sec-ch04-plm).
- **MPI**: Message Passing Interface. Not defined here; used in [Environment parsing and process lifetime (`SNAP_*`)](#sec-ch12-environment).
- **MPS**: Metal Performance Shaders. Not defined here; used in [Dispatch tensor kernels by device (`CUDA`)](#sec-ch01-dispatch).
- **NCCL**: NVIDIA Collective Communications Library; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/external/gloo/README.md#L43-L56). Not defined here; used in [Communication backends: Gloo, UCX through commux, an external group (`BACKEND`)](#sec-ch14-backends).
- **NCO**: NetCDF Operators. Not defined here; used in [Combine and inspect tools (`pd-combine`, `pd-inspect`)](#sec-ch14-tools).
- **PDE**: partial differential equation; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [The notation index](#sec-appa-index).
- **PE**: potential energy. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- **PLM**: piecewise-linear method. Defined in [PLM, the van Leer harmonic-mean slope (`type: plm`)](#sec-ch04-plm).
- **PNETCDF**: parallel NetCDF. Not defined here; used in [Build options and test registration (`cmake -DNAME=value`)](#sec-ch12-build).
- **PPM**: piecewise-parabolic method. Defined in [PPM: accepted by the parser, throws on the first stage (`type: ppm`)](#sec-ch04-ppm).
- **PVRS**: primitive-variable Riemann solver. Defined in [HLLC (`type: hllc`)](#sec-ch04-hllc).
- **RK**: Runge–Kutta. Defined in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- **RK3**: third-order Runge–Kutta. Not defined here; used in [The $x_2$ and $x_3$ face-flux covariance and centroid terms (`SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`)](#sec-ch04-fluxcov).
- **SI**: International System of Units; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [The notation index](#sec-appa-index).
- **SSP**: strong stability preserving. Defined in [Explicit SSP Runge-Kutta stages in Shu-Osher form (`integration/type`)](#sec-ch07-rk).
- **TVD**: total-variation diminishing; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [The notation index](#sec-appa-index).
- **UCX**: Unified Communication X. Not defined here; used in [Dispatch tensor kernels by device (`CUDA`)](#sec-ch01-dispatch).
- **VIC**: vertically implicit correction. Defined in [VIC options and activation: `implicit-scheme` 1 or 9, one block in $x_1$ (`ImplicitOptions`)](#sec-ch07-vic-options).
- **WB**: well-balanced. Not defined here; used in [Well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction: perturbations about a hydrostatic reference (gravity on)](#sec-ch05-wbx1).
- **WENO**: weighted essentially non-oscillatory. Defined in [WENO3 and WENO5 (`type: weno3`, `weno5`)](#sec-ch04-weno).
- **WENO3**: third-order weighted essentially non-oscillatory reconstruction. Not defined here; used in [WENO3 and WENO5 (`type: weno3`, `weno5`)](#sec-ch04-weno).
- **WENO5**: fifth-order weighted essentially non-oscillatory reconstruction. Not defined here; used in [WENO3 and WENO5 (`type: weno3`, `weno5`)](#sec-ch04-weno).
- **YAML**: YAML Ain't Markup Language, the structured input format used for decks. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).

## YAML keys {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- `Ar`: argon count in the composition mapping. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `at-face`: whether bottom temperature relaxation targets the boundary face. Not defined here; used in [Bottom relaxation of temperature, velocity and composition (`relax-bot-temp`, `relax-bot-velo`, `relax-bot-comp`)](#sec-ch09-relax).
- `balance-ic`: whether the driver projects its initial column into balance. Not defined here; used in [`balance_column`: projection of ghost-free columns onto the scheme's discrete balance (C++ and Python API)](#sec-ch05-balcol).
- `balance-ic-passes`: maximum number of saturation/projection passes for the initial column. Not defined here; used in [`balance_column`: projection of ghost-free columns onto the scheme's discrete balance (C++ and Python API)](#sec-ch05-balcol).
- `blocks_per_process`: number of blocks assigned to each process. Not defined here; used in [Advance several blocks in one process (`distribute.blocks_per_process`)](#sec-ch01-mesh).
- `body-heat`: volumetric heating options. Defined in [Body heating, top cooling and bottom heating (`body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat`)](#sec-ch09-heating).
- `bot-heat`: bottom heating options. Defined in [Body heating, top cooling and bottom heating (`body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat`)](#sec-ch09-heating).
- `bot-sponge-lyr`: bottom sponge-layer options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `boundary-condition`: boundary options: `external` boundary-function names for the domain faces and `internal` solid-cell settings. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `bounds`: coordinate bounds. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `btemp`: bottom target temperature. Not defined here; used in [Bottom relaxation of temperature, velocity and composition (`relax-bot-temp`, `relax-bot-velo`, `relax-bot-comp`)](#sec-ch09-relax).
- `cells`: cell counts and ghost-width options. Defined in [The passive-scalar limiter and the complement bound](#sec-ch08-scalar).
- `cfl`: Courant-number limit for the time step. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- `composition`: elemental composition of a species. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `const-gravity`: constant-gravity forcing component. Defined in [Constant gravity and the cell form of the gravity work (`gravity-work: cell`)](#sec-ch06-cell).
- `const-vsed`: prescribed sedimentation velocities indexed by species. Not defined here; used in [Sedimentation of condensates (`sedimentation`)](#sec-ch10-sed).
- `coriolis`: Coriolis-force options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `cv_R`: reference heat capacity divided by the species gas constant. Not defined here; used in [Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`)](#sec-ch02-ideal-moist).
- `density`: particle material densities indexed by species. Defined in [The well-balanced face positivity fallback](#sec-ch08-wbface).
- `density-floor`: minimum admissible density. Not defined here; used in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- `depth`: number of cells over which boundary heating or cooling is distributed. Not defined here; used in [Locate tensor rows, faces and ghost slabs (`NMASS` / `PartOptions`)](#sec-ch01-layout).
- `diameter`: particle diameter used by the reaction-rate model. Not defined here; used in [Precipitation and evaporation kinetics in the example drivers (driver-level coupling)](#sec-ch10-kinetics).
- `diff_c`: reference diffusivity in the reaction-rate model. Not defined here; used in [Precipitation and evaporation kinetics in the example drivers (driver-level coupling)](#sec-ch10-kinetics).
- `diff_P`: pressure exponent of the diffusivity. Not defined here; used in [Precipitation and evaporation kinetics in the example drivers (driver-level coupling)](#sec-ch10-kinetics).
- `diff_T`: temperature exponent of the diffusivity. Not defined here; used in [Precipitation and evaporation kinetics in the example drivers (driver-level coupling)](#sec-ch10-kinetics).
- `diffusion`: viscosity and heat-diffusion options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `dir`: direction selector for solvers that use it. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `disable-flux-x1`: whether the first-coordinate flux is disabled. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `disable-flux-x2`: whether the second-coordinate flux is disabled. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `disable-flux-x3`: whether the third-coordinate flux is disabled. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `distribute`: domain-distribution options. Not defined here; used in [Advance several blocks in one process (`distribute.blocks_per_process`)](#sec-ch01-mesh).
- `double_precision`: whether an output stream writes NetCDF variables as `NC_DOUBLE` instead of `NC_FLOAT` (default false). Not defined here; used in [NetCDF output: per-block files and the combine (`outputs: type: netcdf`)](#sec-ch14-netcdf).
- `dt`: time-step duration. Not defined here; used in [VIC block-tridiagonal assembly: the Roe-linearised flux divergence along a column (`vic_assemble_full_impl`)](#sec-ch07-vic-assembly).
- `dTdt`: prescribed temperature tendency. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `dynamic`: whether viscosity and heat transport use dynamic coefficients. Not defined here; used in [Isotropic viscosity and heat conduction (`forcing/diffusion`)](#sec-ch09-viscosity).
- `dynamics`: hydrodynamic options block. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `eos-file`: equation-of-state table file read by the linked provider. Not defined here; used in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- `equation-of-state`: equation-of-state options. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `external`: boundary-function names for external domain faces. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `flux`: prescribed heat flux. Not defined here; used in [Body heating, top cooling and bottom heating (`body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat`)](#sec-ch09-heating).
- `forcing`: forcing options block: a map with one sub-block per forcing component. Not defined here; used in [Well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction: perturbations about a hydrostatic reference (gravity on)](#sec-ch05-wbx1).
- `formula`: registered reaction-rate formula. Not defined here; used in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- `ftol`: relative convergence tolerance. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `gammad`: dry-gas ratio of specific heats. Defined in [Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`)](#sec-ch02-ideal-moist).
- `geometry`: coordinate-system and grid options. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `grav1`: gravity component along the first coordinate. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `gravity-work`: form of the $x_1$ gravity work: `face` (default), `face-wallc` or `cell`. Defined in [Constant gravity and the cell form of the gravity work (`gravity-work: cell`)](#sec-ch06-cell).
- `gravity-work-fixer`: whether the gravity-work fixer runs (a boolean; default true with `gravity-work: cell`, and it needs `cell`). Defined in [Constant gravity and the cell form of the gravity work (`gravity-work: cell`)](#sec-ch06-cell).
- `H`: hydrogen count in the composition mapping. Not defined here; used in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- `horizontal`: options for the horizontal reconstruction. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `implicit-advection-cfl`: Courant limit for the implicitly treated advection. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `implicit_radial`: whether radial heat conduction on the cubed sphere is solved implicitly, split around the explicit step (default false). Defined in [Viscosity and heat conduction on the cubed sphere (`diffusion` keys on `gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch09-csdiffusion).
- `implicit-scheme`: implicit time-integration scheme selector. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `integration`: time-integration options. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- `internal`: internal-boundary options. Not defined here; used in [Rectify a mask and close fluid faces against solids (`boundary-condition/internal/*; vars["solid"]`)](#sec-ch11-solids).
- `interp_order`: order used for grid interpolation. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `kappa_iso`: isotropic thermal transport coefficient, interpreted according to dynamic. Defined in [Isotropic viscosity and heat conduction (`forcing/diffusion`)](#sec-ch09-viscosity).
- `kappa_scale_x1`: piecewise-linear vertical multiplier for thermal transport. Not defined here; used in [x1 profiles of the diffusion coefficients and the mean-of-products face coefficient (`nu_scale_x1`, `kappa_scale_x1`)](#sec-ch09-x1profile).
- `layout`: block-layout selector. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `limiter`: whether the enclosing component enables its limiter. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `max-iter`: maximum number of iterations. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `N`: nitrogen count in the composition mapping. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `name`: name identifying the enclosing component. Not defined here; used in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- `names`: names of the passive scalars, one per scalar (in the `scalar` block). Not defined here; used in [Transport passive scalars with dry mass (`scalar:`)](#sec-ch01-scalar).
- `nb1`: number of blocks along the first coordinate direction. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `nb2`: number of blocks along the second coordinate direction. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `nb3`: number of blocks along the third coordinate direction. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `ncycle_out`: number of cycles between printed cycle lines; 0 turns the line off. Not defined here; used in [Step rejection for moist causes (`max_redo`)](#sec-ch10-redo).
- `nghost`: number of ghost cells at each boundary. Defined in [The reconstruction framework (`dynamics/reconstruct`)](#sec-ch04-framework).
- `nlim`: maximum number of integration cycles. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- `non-hydrostatic`: fraction of the vertical body force retained by the non-hydrostatic treatment. Defined in [Constant gravity and the cell form of the gravity work (`gravity-work: cell`)](#sec-ch06-cell).
- `nu_iso`: isotropic viscosity coefficient, interpreted according to dynamic. Defined in [Isotropic viscosity and heat conduction (`forcing/diffusion`)](#sec-ch09-viscosity).
- `nx1`: number of cells in the first coordinate direction. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `nx2`: number of cells in the second coordinate direction. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `nx3`: number of cells in the third coordinate direction. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `O`: oxygen count in the composition mapping. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `omega1`: first rotation-rate component: $\Omega_z$ of the Cartesian frame under the default `type: xyz`, the $x_1$ component under `type: 123`. Defined in [Coriolis force in the coordinate frame or from a Cartesian rotation vector (`forcing/coriolis`)](#sec-ch09-coriolis).
- `outputs`: output-stream configuration. Not defined here; used in [Output-field diagnostics: `div`, `curl`, `theta_v`, `ic_*`, paths and means on request (`loadDiagOutputData`)](#sec-ch13-output-diag).
- `pmax`: upper pressure bound of the heating region. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `pmin`: lower pressure bound of the heating region. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `Pref`: thermodynamic reference pressure. Not defined here; used in [Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`)](#sec-ch02-ideal-moist).
- `pressure-floor`: minimum admissible pressure. Not defined here; used in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- `problem`: problem-specific driver options. Not defined here; used in [`balance_column`: projection of ghost-free columns onto the scheme's discrete balance (C++ and Python API)](#sec-ch05-balcol).
- `radius`: particle radii indexed by species. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `rate-constant`: reaction-rate model options. Not defined here; used in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- `reactions`: reaction definitions. Not defined here; used in [Fixed-volume fixed-energy phase equilibrium (`uv-solver`)](#sec-ch02-saturation).
- `reconstruct`: reconstruction options. Not defined here; used in [Follow the hydro increment through seven sections (`dynamics:`)](#sec-ch01-hydro).
- `reference-state`: thermodynamic reference-state options. Not defined here; used in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- `relax-bot-comp`: bottom composition-relaxation options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `relax-bot-temp`: bottom temperature-relaxation options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `relax-bot-velo`: bottom velocity-relaxation options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `riemann-solver`: Riemann-solver options within the enclosing dynamics or scalar block. Not defined here; used in [Follow the hydro increment through seven sections (`dynamics:`)](#sec-ch01-hydro).
- `scalar`: passive-scalar options. Not defined here; used in [Transport passive scalars with dry mass (`scalar:`)](#sec-ch01-scalar).
- `scale`: scaling in the enclosing component: a reconstruction switch or values of a thermal-transport profile. Defined in [Donor cell (`type: dc`)](#sec-ch04-dc).
- `sedimentation`: sedimentation-model options. Not defined here; used in [Sedimentation of condensates (`sedimentation`)](#sec-ch10-sed).
- `shear-cfl`: Courant limit associated with shear. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `shock`: whether reconstruction uses its shock handling. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `solid-density`: density assigned to internal solid cells. Not defined here; used in [Rectify a mask and close fluid faces against solids (`boundary-condition/internal/*; vars["solid"]`)](#sec-ch11-solids).
- `solid-pressure`: pressure assigned to internal solid cells. Not defined here; used in [Rectify a mask and close fluid faces against solids (`boundary-condition/internal/*; vars["solid"]`)](#sec-ch11-solids).
- `species`: species definitions or selection in the enclosing thermodynamic block. Not defined here; used in [Temperature-dependent moist thermodynamics (`moist-mixture`)](#sec-ch02-moist-mixture).
- `tau`: relaxation time scale. Not defined here; used in [Bottom relaxation of temperature, velocity and composition (`relax-bot-temp`, `relax-bot-velo`, `relax-bot-comp`)](#sec-ch09-relax).
- `temperature-floor`: minimum admissible temperature. Not defined here; used in [EOS and solver consistency (`none`)](#sec-ch02-consistency).
- `temperature_inner`: prescribed temperature of the inner x1 wall for heat conduction, in K; 0 (default) leaves the wall insulating. Defined in [Viscosity and heat conduction on the cubed sphere (`diffusion` keys on `gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch09-csdiffusion).
- `temperature_outer`: prescribed temperature of the outer x1 wall for heat conduction, in K; 0 (default) leaves the wall insulating. Defined in [Viscosity and heat conduction on the cubed sphere (`diffusion` keys on `gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch09-csdiffusion).
- `tlim`: simulation end time. Not defined here; used in [Driver loop and accepted steps (`integration:`)](#sec-ch01-driver).
- `top-cool`: top cooling options. Defined in [Body heating, top cooling and bottom heating (`body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat`)](#sec-ch09-heating).
- `top-sponge-lyr`: top sponge-layer options. Not defined here; used in [The forcing loop: parsing, registration and the stage increment (`forcing:`)](#sec-ch09-framework).
- `traditional`: whether to use the traditional Coriolis approximation. Not defined here; used in [Coriolis force in the coordinate frame or from a Cartesian rotation vector (`forcing/coriolis`)](#sec-ch09-coriolis).
- `Tref`: thermodynamic reference temperature. Not defined here; used in [Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`)](#sec-ch02-ideal-moist).
- `type`: implementation selector for the enclosing options block. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `u0_R`: reference internal energy in the species gas-constant normalisation. Not defined here; used in [Constant-heat-capacity moist mixture (`ideal-moist`)](#sec-ch02-ideal-moist).
- `upper-bound`: upper bound for the scalar ratio; a negative value disables the bound. Not defined here; used in [Transport passive scalars with dry mass (`scalar:`)](#sec-ch01-scalar).
- `uv-solver`: solver used for fixed-energy saturation adjustment. Defined in [Saturation adjustment in the step (top-level `reactions`)](#sec-ch10-satadj).
- `variables`: variables requested by an output stream. Not defined here; used in [Output-field diagnostics: `div`, `curl`, `theta_v`, `ic_*`, paths and means on request (`loadDiagOutputData`)](#sec-ch13-output-diag).
- `vertical`: options for the vertical reconstruction. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `vm`: molar volume used by the reaction-rate model. Not defined here; used in [Precipitation and evaporation kinetics in the example drivers (driver-level coupling)](#sec-ch10-kinetics).
- `wall_velocity`: viscous condition at the radial walls on the cubed sphere: stress-free (default) or no-slip. Defined in [Viscosity and heat conduction on the cubed sphere (`diffusion` keys on `gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch09-csdiffusion).
- `wb-wall-clamp`: whether to clamp the well-balanced wall continuation. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `weight`: molar mass of the gas. Not defined here; used in [EOS interface and dispatch (`type`)](#sec-ch02-interface).
- `width`: physical width of the sponge layer. Not defined here; used in [Sponge layers: Rayleigh drag near the top and bottom boundaries (`top-sponge-lyr`, `bot-sponge-lyr`)](#sec-ch09-sponge).

- `x1min`: lower bound of the first coordinate. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `x1-outer`: boundary name on the outer first-coordinate face. Not defined here; used in [Construct a MeshBlock and its modules (`MeshBlockOptions`)](#sec-ch01-construction).
- `x2-inner`: boundary name on the inner second-coordinate face. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `x2max`: upper bound of the second coordinate. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).

- `x2min`: lower bound of the second coordinate. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `x2min_pi`: lower bound of the second coordinate in multiples of pi. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `x2-outer`: boundary name on the outer second-coordinate face. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `x3-inner`: boundary name on the inner third-coordinate face. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `x3max`: upper bound of the third coordinate. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `x3max_pi`: upper bound of the third coordinate in multiples of pi. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `x3min`: lower bound of the third coordinate. Not defined here; used in [One global grid, sliced per block (YAML `geometry`)](#sec-ch03-globalgrid).
- `x3min_pi`: lower bound of the third coordinate in multiples of pi. Not defined here; used in [Gnomonic equiangular cubed sphere (`gnomonic-equiangle`)](#sec-ch03-gnomonic).
- `x3-outer`: boundary name on the outer third-coordinate face. Defined in [YAML scheme selection and setup guards (`YAML keys`)](#sec-ch12-yaml).
- `xfrac`: target species mole fractions. Not defined here; used in [Bottom relaxation of temperature, velocity and composition (`relax-bot-temp`, `relax-bot-velo`, `relax-bot-comp`)](#sec-ch09-relax).

## Symbols {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- $A_{i\pm1/2}$: $x_1$ face area. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\alpha_{\mathrm{adm}}$: the admissibility factor in $[0,1]$ that scales a radiating ghost toward the background; never bare $\alpha$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/bc/bc_func.cpp#L187-L203). Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $\alpha_{\mathrm{nh}}$: non-hydrostatic factor in $[0,1]$: the fraction of gravity applied as a body force. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $B$: the binomial weights $(1,4,6,4,1)/16$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_ref_x1_impl.h#L104-L108). Defined in [6. Hydrostatic reference state](#sec-appa-6).
- $\bar q_i$: the cell average stored by the code, written with the bar only where a point value of the same quantity also appears. The overbar means the cell average and nothing else: a midpoint, a reference or a background value never carries a bar; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $\boldsymbol\delta_i$: the implicit solve's unknown in cell $i$ (total mass, normal momentum, [tangential momenta], energy). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $C$: Courant number (named: acoustic, advective, vertical acoustic). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\chi$: the ratio $\rho/p$ used by the default reference and its wall continuation [s$^2$ m$^{-2}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\chi^s_i$: the binomially smoothed $\chi$ of the default reference; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_ref_x1_impl.h#L74-L108). Defined in [6. Hydrostatic reference state](#sec-appa-6).
- $c_s$: sound speed [m s$^{-1}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $c_T$: isothermal sound speed [m s$^{-1}$], $c_s = \sqrt{\gamma}\,c_T$. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $c_v, c_p$: mixture specific heats **per unit total mass**, $c_v = \sum_n y_n c_{v,n}$ over dry air and every species [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; a chapter that needs the per-dry-mass form writes it out and says so. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $c_{v,n}, c_{p,n}$: specific heats of species $n$ at constant volume and pressure, **per unit mass of that species** [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; $c_{v,n} = c^{\mathrm{ref}}_n R_n$ with $c^{\mathrm{ref}}_n$ the dimensionless table value. $n=\mathrm{d}$ is dry air: $c_{v,\mathrm{d}}, c_{p,\mathrm{d}}$. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\delta_i$: centroid offset $x_{1,i}-x^{\mathrm{m}}_{1,i}$ (zero on Cartesian); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp#L95-L105). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\Delta_i[q]$: $x_1$ face difference over cell $i$, $q_{i+1/2}-q_{i-1/2}$; with areas, $\Delta_i[Aq] = A_{i+1/2}q_{i+1/2}-A_{i-1/2}q_{i-1/2}$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/coordinate.cpp#L569-L586). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$: the explicit stage increment handed to the implicit solve. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\Delta_\pm$: centroid spacings $x_{1,i+1}-x_{1,i}$ ($+$) and $x_{1,i}-x_{1,i-1}$ ($-$), used in non-uniform stencils; never $h_\pm$, which would read as cell widths; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp#L66-L71). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\Delta q$: the change of $q$ over one RK stage, stated each time as "per stage" or "per step"; on a state variable in an implicit context write $\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho$ for the stage change and keep $\Delta\rho_i$ for the solved change of the row below; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\Delta\rho_i$: the total density change solved by the implicit step, after redistribution and clamps; never the plain stage change, which is $\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\delta\rho_i$, $\delta E_i$: the total-mass and energy components of $\boldsymbol\delta_i$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\Delta t$: the step. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\Delta t_c$: the time step handed to the implicit solve: $w_{2,s}\Delta t$ under rk3 and rk3s4, $\Delta t$ under rk1 and rk2. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\dot q$: time derivative of a cell average produced by one operator (stated each time); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $d_q = q_i - q_{\mathrm{bg},i}$: the interior perturbation the characteristic split acts on; $d$ always carries the quantity it belongs to, because bare $d$ is not used; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/bc/bc_func.cpp#L172-L176). Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $e$: specific internal energy [J kg$^{-1}$]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L278-L281). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $E$: total energy density, internal plus kinetic, $\rho e + \tfrac12\rho\lvert\mathbf v\rvert^2$ [J m$^{-3}$]; excludes potential energy. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\epsilon_{\mathrm{m}}$: machine epsilon of the working precision (never bare $\epsilon$, which is $\epsilon_{\mathrm{piv}}$); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/flux_positivity.cpp#L11-L14). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\epsilon_{\mathrm{piv}}$: LU pivot tolerance; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/math/ludcmp.h#L28-L35). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $F_{i+1/2}$: total $x_1$ mass flux density at face $i+\tfrac12$, the sum of the dry and every mass-carrying species row [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$]. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $F^{\mathrm{ref}}$: the total $x_1$ mass flux as the Riemann solver returns it (dry plus every species row), before sedimentation and the positivity limiter change the flux; under `gravity-work: cell` only $F-F^{\mathrm{ref}}$ is booked as face work. Not a reference-state flux: the superscript is not the hydrostatic $\mathrm{ref}$ of §6 (the code comment writes $F^R$) [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$]. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $f_\varepsilon, f_\sigma$: the ideal-moist mixture factors, $f_\varepsilon = 1+\sum_{n\in\mathcal V}y_n(\mu_{\mathrm{d}}/\mu_n-1)-\sum_{n\in\mathcal C}y_n$ and $f_\sigma = 1+\sum_n y_n(c_{v,n}/c_{v,\mathrm{d}}-1)$, both dimensionless [-]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $g_1, g_2, g_3$: constant gravity components [m s$^{-2}$]; $g_1<0$ points to decreasing $x_1$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $g_{ab}$: covariant panel metric, mapping contravariant velocity to covariant momentum per density [-]. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\gamma$: mixture ratio of specific heats $c_p/c_v$, local, varies with composition, dimensionless [-]; $\gamma_{\mathrm{d}}$ is the dry value. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $G_{i+1/2}$: $x_1$ mass flow through the face, $A_{i+1/2}F_{i+1/2}$ (per steradian on spherical-polar); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/coordinate.cpp#L569-L586). Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $H$: a density or pressure scale height [m]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/tests/test_cubed_sphere_cell_volume.py#L70-L74). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\hat h$: specific enthalpy $e + p/\rho$ [J kg$^{-1}$]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L278-L281). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\hat h_n$: specific enthalpy of species $n$ [J kg$^{-1}$], $\hat h_n = u^{\star}_n + c_{p,n}T$ for a gas and without the $R_nT$ term for a condensate; always with the hat, because $h$ is the cell width (§1). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\hat s_n$: specific entropy of species $n$ [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; the hat distinguishes it from the centroid slope $s_i$ of §4, which is never a thermodynamic quantity; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $h_i$: $x_1$ width of cell $i$, $x_{1,i+1/2}-x_{1,i-1/2}$; written $\Delta x_1$ where the direction must be explicit. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $i, j, k$: cell indices in $x_1, x_2, x_3$. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $i\pm\tfrac12$: the $x_1$ faces of cell $i$; also written $f$ for a generic face; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $k = 1..N_r$: reaction index and the number of reactions; never the $x_3$ cell index $k$ (§1) — a chapter that needs both renames the reaction index to $\varkappa$ and says so. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\kappa$: thermal diffusivity (or conductivity, stated); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/diffusion.cpp#L605-L639). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $\kappa_{\mathrm{R}}$: mean opacity [m$^2$ kg$^{-1}$]; never bare $\kappa$, which is thermal diffusivity (§8); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $K_f$: a diffusion coefficient evaluated on face $f$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/diffusion.cpp#L139-L159). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $K_k$: equilibrium constant of reaction $k$ [units stated per reaction]; never $K_f$, a face diffusion coefficient (§8), and never $\mathcal K$, the curvature flux (§3); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/equilibrium/phase_equilibrate_tp.h#L16-L35). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $l$: stencil offset index ($\bar\rho_{i+l}$); never $k$, which is the $x_3$ index. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\Lambda$: diagonal matrix of characteristic speeds. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\lambda_w$: a wavelength (named); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [9. Diagnostics and errors](#sec-appa-9).
- $\langle q\rangle_{V_i}$: volume average of a function $q(x)$ over cell $i$ on its own measure, $\tfrac{1}{V_i}\int_{V_i}q\,dV$; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $L_{n\to m}$: latent heat of the phase change from species $n$ to species $m$ at the reference state, $L_{n\to m} = u^{\star}_n - u^{\star}_m$ (plus the $\mathcal R T/\mu$ term where the vapour side is a gas) [J kg$^{-1}$]; snapy stores no latent heat, only the $u^{\star}_n$ it is a difference of. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\lVert\cdot\rVert_\infty$, $\lVert\cdot\rVert_1$: max-norm and 1-norm errors of a named quantity, e.g. $\lVert W^{\mathrm{D}}-g_1\langle F\rangle\rVert_\infty$; never $e_\infty$ or $e_1$, because $e$ is the specific internal energy (§2), and never $\mathcal E$, which is the conserved energy functional (§5); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [9. Diagnostics and errors](#sec-appa-9).
- $m_1, m_2, m_3$: momentum density $\rho v_a$. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathbf F_a$: the numerical flux vector through faces normal to $x_a$. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\mathbf U$: conserved state vector $(\rho_d, m_1, m_2, m_3, E, \rho_1..\rho_{N_y})$. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathbf U^{(s)}$: state after RK stage $s$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L800-L808). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\mathbf v = (v_1,v_2,v_3)$: velocity [m s$^{-1}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathbf W$: primitive state vector $(\rho, v_1, v_2, v_3, p, y_1..y_{N_y})$. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathcal D$: the $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ defect of a step, the quantity the gravity-work fixer removes [J]. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\mathcal E$: the conserved energy functional of a scheme, named each time ($\mathcal E = \sum_iV_iE_i+P$ under D, $\sum_iV_iE_i+\mathrm{PE}_d$ under the plain face form). Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\mathcal F^E_{i+1/2}$: $x_1$ energy flux density (enthalpy and kinetic energy advection, pressure work). Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\mathcal I$: the interior cells of a block; $\partial\mathcal I$ its boundary faces. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\mathcal K_f$: the cp3/cp5/weno5 curvature flux, $\mathcal K_{i-1/2} = \tfrac{1}{12}(x_{1,i}-x_{1,i-1})(m_{1,i}-m_{1,i-1})$, zero at physical $x_1$ boundaries. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\mathcal L$: the semi-discrete right-hand side (all explicit operators); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\mathcal N_i$: the stencil set of the centroid slope of cell $i$ (stencil cells indexed by $l$); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp#L60-L87). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $\mathcal O$: an oracle (exact or reference value); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [9. Diagnostics and errors](#sec-appa-9).
- $\mathcal P$: the exact potential energy $\int\rho\phi\,dV$ of a smooth density field; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\mathcal R$: universal gas constant [J mol$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; the only molar quantity in this table. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathcal V, \mathcal C$: the vapour and condensate index sets; $n\in\mathcal V$ runs $1..N_v$ and $n\in\mathcal C$ runs $N_v+1..N_y$, in that order, as the rows are stored. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\mathcal W[\cdot]$: the reconstruction operator (PLM, WENO5, cp3/cp5, ...) acting on cell values. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\mathrm{KE}, \mathrm{IE}$: kinetic and internal energy **totals** over the domain (logged `ke=`, `ie=`) [J]; the per-cell internal energy density is $\rho e$ [J m$^{-3}$] and is never written `ie`. Defined in [9. Diagnostics and errors](#sec-appa-9).
- $\mathrm{PE}_d$: discrete potential energy $\sum_iV_i\rho_i\phi_i$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\mathsf A_i, \mathsf B_i, \mathsf C_i$: the diagonal, lower and upper blocks of row $i$ of the block-tridiagonal system. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\mathsf A^{\pm}$: the Roe dissipation matrices $\mathsf R\lvert\Lambda\rvert\mathsf R^{-1}$ at faces $i\pm\tfrac12$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\mathsf I$: the identity matrix, sized by context; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L349-L355). Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\mathsf N$: the stoichiometry matrix, $\mathsf N_{nk} = \nu_{nk}$, species by reaction; never $\mathsf S$, which is the centroid-slope matrix (§4). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\mathsf R, \mathsf R^{-1}$: right eigenvectors and their inverse. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $\mathsf S$: the matrix of $s$: $(\mathsf S q)_i = s_i[q] = \sum_l\mathsf S_{il}q_l$ (row $i$: the weights of the cells $l$ in the slope of $i$; the code stores the transpose); $\tilde{\mathsf S}$ likewise for $\tilde s$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L349-L374). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $M$, $M_{\mathrm{wall}}$: total mass of the domain, and total mass of the $x_1$ wall cells. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\mu_n$: molar mass of species $n$ [kg mol$^{-1}$]; $\mu_{\mathrm{d}}$ for dry air. Never bare $\mu$, which is dynamic viscosity (§8); the code stores the inverse. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\mu$, $\nu$: dynamic and kinematic viscosity; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/diffusion.cpp#L595-L600). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $n_1, n_2, n_3$: interior cells per block in each direction. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\nabla_{\!1}\!\cdot G$: discrete $x_1$ divergence, $\Delta_i[AF]/V_i$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/coordinate.cpp#L569-L586). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $n_g$: ghost cells on each side. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\nu_{nk}$: stoichiometric coefficient of species $n$ in reaction $k$, always with both indices; never bare $\nu$, which is kinematic viscosity (§8). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $N_v, N_c, N_y$: the number of vapours, of condensates, and of species rows, $N_y=N_v+N_c$ (count). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\Omega$: planetary rotation rate; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/coriolis.cpp#L83-L90). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $\omega^{\mathrm{lo}}_i, \omega^{\mathrm{hi}}_i$: the implicit face-work weights $\tfrac12A_{i\mp1/2}\lvert x_{1,i}-x_{1,i\mp1/2}\rvert/V_i$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\operatorname{cov}_i(a,b)$: the in-cell covariance $\langle ab\rangle_{V_i} - \langle a\rangle_{V_i}\langle b\rangle_{V_i}$; to leading order $\sigma_i^2\,\partial_1a\,\partial_1b$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L63-L72). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $p$: pressure [Pa]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $P$: corrected discrete potential energy $\sum_iV_i[\rho_i\phi_i - g_1\sigma_i^2s_i[\rho]]$, exact to $O(h^4)$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\partial_1 q$, $\partial_1^2 q$, $\partial_1^3 q$: derivatives of a smooth field $q(x_1)$ with respect to $x_1$, evaluated where stated; a prime is never used for a derivative, because $\rho'$ is the reference perturbation (§6); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $\partial\mathbf F/\partial\mathbf U$: flux Jacobian. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\phi$: gravitational potential, $\phi(x_1) = -g_1x_1$ (increases upward); never an angle. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $\Phi$: the gravity source Jacobian; upright, not sans-serif like the other matrices, because the math font has no sans-serif Greek and `\mathsf` drops the glyph in the PDF. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $\phi_i$, $\phi_{i\pm1/2}$: $\phi$ at the centroid and at the faces. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $p_{\mathrm{sat},k}(T)$: saturation vapour pressure of the condensing reaction $k$ [Pa], valid only on $[T_{\min,k}, T_{\max,k}]$; the code fits $\ln p_{\mathrm{sat},k}$, so a chapter that quotes the fit quotes the logarithm. Never $e_s$: $e$ is the specific internal energy. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $q_{\mathrm{bg}}$: the saved background value of a primitive $q$ at a radiating boundary. Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $q^{\mathrm{L}}_f, q^{\mathrm{R}}_f$: reconstructed left and right states of a quantity $q$ at face $f$. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $[q]_{\mathrm{walls}}$: $q$ at the top wall minus $q$ at the bottom wall; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $q^{\pm}$: upper/lower in $x_1$; used only for faces of one cell, $q_\pm = q_{i\pm1/2}$; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [3. Fluxes, reconstruction and Riemann solver](#sec-appa-3).
- $q(x_{1,i})$: point value at the centroid; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $r$: $x_1$ on a spherical-polar grid (radius) [m]. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\rho$: total density, dry plus every species that carries mass [kg m$^{-3}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\rho_{\mathrm{d}}$: dry-air density [kg m$^{-3}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\rho_{\mathrm{ref}}, p_{\mathrm{ref}}$: cell reference density and pressure of the well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction. Defined in [6. Hydrostatic reference state](#sec-appa-6).
- $\rho_{\mathrm{sf}}, p_{\mathrm{sf}}$: face ("scan face") reference density and pressure; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L395-L401). Defined in [6. Hydrostatic reference state](#sec-appa-6).
- $\rho_n$: partial density of species $n$, $\rho y_n$ [kg m$^{-3}$]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\rho' = \rho - \rho_{\mathrm{ref}}$: the perturbation the reconstruction acts on; the prime means "minus the reference", never a derivative; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L395-L401). Defined in [6. Hydrostatic reference state](#sec-appa-6).
- $R_{\mathrm{d}}$, $R_n$: specific gas constants of dry air and species $n$ [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L40-L43). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $r_n$: mass mixing ratio of species $n$ **per unit dry mass**, $r_n = \rho_n/\rho_{\mathrm{d}}$, dimensionless [-]; used only where the code is per dry air (passive tracers, @sec-ch10-tracer). Never written $r$ without its species subscript, because $r$ alone is the radius (§1). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $R_n = \mathcal R/\mu_n$: specific gas constant of species $n$ [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; defined for gases only — a condensate has no $R_n$ and contributes no pressure; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/eos/ideal_moist.cpp#L40-L43). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\sigma_i^2$: variance of $x_1$ about the centroid over cell $i$ on its own measure, $\langle (x_1-x_{1,i})^2\rangle_{V_i}$. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\sigma_{\mathrm{SB}}$: Stefan-Boltzmann constant; never bare $\sigma$, which is the cell variance (§1); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $s_i[q]$: centroid slope: the $x_1$ derivative at $x_{1,i}$ of the quadratic through $(x_{1,k}, q_k)$, $k\in\{i-1,i,i+1\}$ inside a block and the three cells next to the end at each $x_1$ end of a block (`centroid_slope`); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp#L60-L92). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $S_n = y_n/y_{\mathrm{sat},n}$: saturation ratio of vapour $n$, dimensionless [-]; never $\mathsf S$ (slope matrix, §4) or $\hat s$ (entropy, §2); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $s^{\star}_n$: reference specific entropy of species $n$ at the thermodynamic reference state, $s^{\star}_n = s^{\mathrm{ref}}_n\mathcal R/\mu_n$ [J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$]; starred for the same reason as $u^{\star}_n$. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $T$: temperature [K]. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\tau$: a relaxation time scale (named); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/relax_bot_temp.cpp#L102-L105). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $\tau_{\mathrm{rad}}$: radiative relaxation time, $c_v/(16\kappa_{\mathrm{R}}\sigma_{\mathrm{SB}}T^3\varepsilon_{\mathrm{esc}})$; never bare $\tau$ (§8); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $\theta$: $x_2$ on a spherical-polar grid (colatitude) [rad]. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\Theta$: the positivity limiter's donor factor in $[0,1]$: the fraction of a requested face flux the limiter allows. Capital, because $\theta$ is the colatitude. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\theta_p$: dry potential temperature, $\theta_p = T(p_\star/p)^{R_{\mathrm{d}}/c_{p,\mathrm{d}}}$ [K], referred to the thermodynamic reference pressure $p_\star$ of §2a and formed with the **dry** constants whatever the composition; the book uses dry constants, while the code computes `theta` from entropy; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/output/load_diag_output_data.cpp#L98-L104). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\theta_v$: virtual potential temperature: $\theta_p$ of the dry-equivalent state with the same density [K]; defined in the chapter that first uses it; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/output/load_diag_output_data.cpp#L98-L104). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $\tilde c_n$: molar concentration of species $n$ [mol m$^{-3}$]; the tilde separates it from the specific heats $c_{v,n}, c_{p,n}$ and the sound speed $c_s$. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $\tilde s_i[q]$: the tridiagonal (lumped) form of $s_i$ held by the implicit matrix: identical inside, the third end weight added to the neighbour's; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L349-L374). Defined in [4. Operators and averages](#sec-appa-4).
- $t^n$: time at step $n$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $T_\star, p_\star$: the **thermodynamic** reference state: the single temperature and pressure at which $c^{\mathrm{ref}}_n$, $u^{\mathrm{ref}}_n$ and $s^{\mathrm{ref}}_n$ are tabulated (defaults $300$ K and $10^5$ Pa) [K], [Pa]. The star is never used for the hydrostatic reference state of §6, which is a per-cell field written with the subscript $\mathrm{ref}$. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $u^{\star}_n$: reference specific internal energy of species $n$ at the thermodynamic reference state, $u^{\star}_n = u^{\mathrm{ref}}_n\mathcal R/\mu_n$ [J kg$^{-1}$]; the energy zero of each species, not a fitted constant. The star, not a superscript $(0)$, because $(0)$ is the explicit RK increment (§7). Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $V^{(1)}_i$: the $x_1$ factor of the cell volume, $V_{ijk}=\varpi_{jk}V^{(1)}_i$: $\tfrac13(x_{1,i+1/2}^3-x_{1,i-1/2}^3)$ on spherical-polar, $h_i$ on Cartesian; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/spherical_polar.cpp#L200-L211). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\varepsilon$: relative error of the linear convective onset growth rate against its oracle; $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{eff}}$ the one-step effective value; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [9. Diagnostics and errors](#sec-appa-9).
- $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{esc}}$: escape probability of the time-step limiter; never bare $\varepsilon$, which is the onset error (§9); notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
- $\varphi$: $x_3$ on a spherical-polar grid (azimuth) [rad]; never the potential. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\varpi_{jk}$: horizontal factor of a cell volume, $V_{ijk}=\varpi_{jk}V^{(1)}_i$: the solid angle on spherical-polar ($V^{(1)}_i=\tfrac13(r_{+}^3-r_{-}^3)$), $\Delta x_2\Delta x_3$ on Cartesian ($V^{(1)}_i=h_i$); [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/spherical_polar.cpp#L200-L211). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\vartheta$: local phase $\pi h/\lambda_w$ of a wave of wavelength $\lambda_w$ in a Fourier error estimate; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $V_i$: cell volume. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $w_0^{(s)}, w_1^{(s)}, w_2^{(s)}$: the weights of RK stage $s$: $\mathbf U \leftarrow w_0^{(s)}\mathbf U^n + w_1^{(s)}\mathbf U + w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathcal L(\mathbf U)$. Defined in [7. Time integration and the implicit solver](#sec-appa-7).
- $W_i$: $x_1$ gravity work per unit volume and time booked into $E$ in cell $i$ [W m$^{-3}$]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp#L48-L51). Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $W^{\mathrm{cell}}_i$: cell form $\rho_iv_{1,i}g_1$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $W^{\mathrm{D}}_i$: corrected-PE face work $W^{\mathrm{face}}_i + g_1\sigma_i^2s_i[\dot\rho]$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $W^{\mathrm{face}}_i$: face form $\tfrac{1}{V_i}[\phi_i\Delta_i[AF]-\Delta_i[A\phi F]]$. Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $w_{{\mathrm{s}},n}$: sedimentation (terminal) velocity of species $n$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/sedimentation/sed_hydro.cpp#L18-L31). Defined in [8. Diffusion, sedimentation, forcing](#sec-appa-8).
- $W^{\mathrm{wallc}}_i$: the `face-wallc` work: $W^{\mathrm{face}}_i$ in interior cells, $W^{\mathrm{cell}}_i$ in the two $x_1$ wall cells; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L1090-L1097). Defined in [5. Gravity, potential energy and gravity work](#sec-appa-5).
- $x_{1,i}$: cell volume centroid ($r_{c,i}$ on spherical-polar). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $x_{1,i\pm1/2}$: face positions. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $x_1, x_2, x_3$: the three coordinate directions; $x_1$ is always the vertical (radial) direction. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\xi, \eta$: the two gnomonic-equiangle panel coordinates of a cubed-sphere block ($x_2, x_3$) [rad]; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/gnomonic_equiangle.cpp#L59-L72). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $x^{\mathrm{m}}_{1,i}$: cell midpoint $\tfrac12(x_{1,i-1/2}+x_{1,i+1/2})$ ($r^{\mathrm{m}}_i$ on spherical-polar); it is not the cell average of $x_1$, which is the centroid $x_{1,i}$; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/coord/cartesian.cpp#L26-L27). Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $y_{\mathrm{sat},n}$: the mass fraction of vapour $n$ in equilibrium with its condensate at the cell's $T$ and $\rho$, dimensionless [-]; the target of the saturation adjustment, not a stored variable; notation only; see @sec-appa. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $y_n$: mass fraction of species $n$ **per unit total mass**, $\rho_n = \rho y_n$, dimensionless [-]; this is snapy's composition variable and the only one the state vector carries. Defined in [2. State, thermodynamics and species](#sec-appa-2).
- $z$: $x_1$ on a Cartesian grid (height) [m]. Defined in [1. Coordinates and grids](#sec-appa-1).
- $\zeta_k$: equilibrium concentration shift for reaction $k$, distinct from local sponge/profile coordinates [mol m$^{-3}$]. Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $Z_n$: compressibility factor of gas species $n$, $p_n = Z_n\rho_nR_nT$, dimensionless [-]; $Z_n=1$ at the pin, because kintera's `func2` registry is empty. Capital, because $z$ is the Cartesian height (§1). Defined in [2a. Species thermodynamics, phase change and reactions](#sec-appa-2a).
- $Z = \rho_{\mathrm{bg}}c_{s,\mathrm{bg}}$: the background acoustic impedance; [source](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/c0c38593d3d3f37bebe204a590610fd7daa05a5f/src/bc/bc_func.cpp#L172-L178). Defined in [8a. Radiation and the radiating boundary](#sec-appa-8a).
